description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a high-performance agent workspace that keeps a complete record of everything it did.
summary: Maka's core design decision is that the append-only log of every RuntimeEvent—model messages, tool calls, permission grants, terminations—is the actual runtime, and the desktop UI, crash recovery, and next prompt are all just projections of that log. That's exactly the observability contract I want for PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket: when I'm routing a dozen sessions in VS Code or driving a Claude run from my phone, I need a replayable record I can audit after the fact, not a black box that tells me it finished. I also respect that they publish per-task benchmarks against other harnesses on the same model and official verifier instead of shipping a single marketing number.
